thread:
nina: quick flag — migration guide draft missing a few runtime edgecases for v1->v2 swap. want to capture before we publish.

leo: which edgecases?

nina: two small ones: 1) model alias swap can briefly return vectors with previous dimension if routing cache isn't invalidated; 2) SDK param renames are warned but not enforced, so callers may silently send old names.

anjali: agree these are important. I can add a short troubleshooting subsection: how to verify embed dims, flush cache for Dedicated, and recommended smoke tests.

nina: perfect. add a tiny curl + node smoke test that asserts embedding length and logs model name.

leo: also include a param mapping table: top_k -> candidate_count, n_candidates -> candidate_count, and note silent ignore behavior.

nina: exact wording: "If you see unexpected embedding lengths after switching an alias, run the smoke test and flush alias cache. Do not assume dims are identical across model versions."

anjali: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521. docs-ci-bot kicked off checks.

docs-ci-bot: PR 4521 opened by anjali 1 lint and build started.

leo: ping infra for alias-cache TTL check.

nina: will coordinate banner copy with product once PR merges. aim to land by tomorrow.

anjali: merged after nits. added changelog entry to next sprint for stricter SDK validation.

nina: thanks team. small but useful save for customers. :tada:
